description: Implement login activity tracking that logs every login with IP, user agent, device, browser, platform, country; detects new device or new country logins; sends email alerts for suspicious activity. Store in login_activities table.
steps: Create login_activities migration with columns: id, user_id (foreign key to users), ip_address (string, 45 chars for IPv6), user_agent (text), device (string), browser (string), platform (string), country (string, 2 chars), city (string), is_suspicious (boolean, default false), logged_in_at (timestamp), created_at, updated_at
Create app/Models/LoginActivity.php Eloquent model with belongsTo User relationship and casts for logged_in_at timestamp
Install jenssegers/agent package via composer for user agent parsing: 'composer require jenssegers/agent'

Create app/Services/LoginActivityService.php with methods: recordLogin(User, Request), detectSuspiciousLogin(User, array loginData), getRecentLogins(User, limit=10), getDeviceName(userAgent), getBrowserName(userAgent), getPlatformName(userAgent)
Use ipapi.co or ip-api.com free geolocation API in LoginActivityService to get country and city from IP address (with fallback to 'Unknown' on API failure)

Create app/Notifications/SuspiciousLoginNotification.php email following OtpService branded template style with login details: IP, location, device, browser, timestamp, and 'Sign out all other devices' link
Update LoginController.php store() method to call LoginActivityService->recordLogin() after successful Auth::attempt() but before redirect

In recordLogin(), check if this is a new device (no prior login_activities with same device+browser+platform) or new country (no prior login_activities with same country) - if yes, mark is_suspicious=true and send email notification
Test login activity: log in from different browsers, verify database records, verify suspicious login email sent on first login from new browser/device
acceptance_criteria: Every successful login creates a login_activities record with IP, user agent, device, browser, platform, country, city
First login from a new device or new country is marked suspicious and triggers email alert
Email alert contains login details and link to sign out other devices
Recent login history is stored and can be queried per user
User agent parsing correctly identifies device, browser, and platform
Geolocation API provides country and city for IP addresses
verification: Run 'composer require jenssegers/agent' to install user agent parser
Log in with valid credentials from Chrome browser
Check login_activities table: 'php artisan tinker' then 'App\Models\LoginActivity::latest()->first()' - verify record exists with correct IP, browser='Chrome', platform='Windows'
Check for suspicious login email (should be sent on first login from this device)
Log in again from same browser - verify NO suspicious login email sent
Log in from Firefox browser - verify new login_activities record created and suspicious login email sent
Verify storage/logs/laravel.log shows no errors during login
